verdict.rationale: Docs say the quickstart lets you save and search a memory in Python or JavaScript after installing the SDK, and show a Python-style client.add(messages, user_id=...) call, so official SDKs in both languages are implied. Nothing explicitly confirms TypeScript typings or that the two SDKs expose equivalent memory APIs. Missing for 10: explicit TypeScript SDK documentation, evidence of API parity between the Python and JS SDKs (add/search/update/delete, filters, features), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
